focused_attempts.interpretation: The 93-case frozen G5 run had six failures. Review classified them as test setup/oracle issues: global ancestor preflight expects null job and unchanged intent; error-ack injection must happen in same call as filesystem error; retry-ack must seed ERROR through a real claim/error (generation 1); the second TestClient inherited the seeded session cookie; and the observation marker oracle omitted the independently required CLI shutdown marker. No product defect was established by these failures. The failed run remains immutable evidence and the full gate must be rerun after correction.
